test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

Earlier I'd thought that it was for my sake, but then I learnt ______ Arjun the power to resist her.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**what gave**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the verb should also be in the past tense.
 
• "**Learnt**" is already in the past tense, so the verb that follows should be past participle.
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**I**", so the correct form of the verb is "**gave**" (past participle of "give").
 
• "**what gave**" - This is a relative clause that introduces the reason or source of Arjun's power to resist.
 
• In the complete sentence, "**gave**" is used because the sentence discusses something that happened in the past, specifically the action or source that provided Arjun with the power to resist someone.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence**: *Earlier I'd thought that it was for my sake, but then I learnt what gave__ Arjun the power to resist her.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**What has gave**", is incorrect because it uses the present perfect tense.
 
• "**What gives**", is incorrect because it uses the present tense.
 
• "**What give**", is incorrect because it uses the present tense.
